section_prompt: Genetic testing is the first step in personalized medicine and pharmacogenomics. Pharmacogenomics uses genetic information to find the best medicine or treatment for a disease, for example when doctors predict how an individual’s genes will respond to certain cancer drugs. In some cases doctors analyze particular genes associated with the cancer, and in other cases they may analyze the entire genome of the individual.
item_text: If I were diagnosed with cancer, I would consider having my genes analysed in order to help chose a cancer treatment with the fewest side effects.
